scope: Proposition 5.1 (Descent of invariant twisted forms) of the manuscript “Invariant anticanonical indices and conversion of twisted differentials” (preprints/Invariant-anticanonical-indices-and-conversion-of-twisted-differentials-September-26-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 068 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 c40b47629aa1aa95), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 16. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let ν : S → X, F, and T be the finite-cover data just specified. After choosing invariant canonical frames on Cb and C, there is, for every r ≥ 0 and 0 ≤ p ≤ dim F, an injective linear map H0 (F, Ωp F ⊗ (−KF )r )T −→ H0 (S, Ωp S ⊗ (−KS)r ). For some fixed p, the target is nonzero at unbounded positive integers r.
